transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I... well, I guess I got scared enough to finally make an appointment. Just... I keep having these thoughts. Like maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. And... I don't know, sometimes when I'm driving home from the clinic, I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just... didn't turn the wheel. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Are you thinking of acting on these thoughts of ending your life?
I... I don't know. I haven't done anything. But like I said, it just... it scared me enough to actually come in here. Just the fact that I'm even wondering about it when I'm driving... I don't know.
Have you been feeling depressed most days?

Yeah... most days. It's just... everything feels kind of gray. Even when the house is loud and there's a lot going on, I just... I don't feel any of it. I usually just hide in the laundry room and cry because... I just don't want anyone to see how bad it is. How hopeless it feels.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for days or weeks at a time?

Um... I don't really know about other times in my life. It's just... this feeling hasn't really stopped. It's been hanging over me for... probably about 11 months now. It's just that this past month is when it got... unbearable.
Did this start after something major happened in your life?
No... not really. Um... nothing I can think of, anyway. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing major stands out.
Before these past 11 months, was there ever another separate time in your life when you felt this depressed?
Um... no. Not that I can remember. It's... hard to think back before all this, but... no. I don't think so.
Do you often become terrified that people will leave you or abandon you?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I don't think about that. People just... do what they do.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Um... yeah. I suppose so. I just... I haven't really touched my camera. And the bird feeders... I don't check them with any real interest anymore. Or care what's coming up in the garden. It's... it's a little frightening, I guess. Just because... those things used to be how I felt like myself. But now... I just don't.
Have you been feeling worthless?

Um... I suppose so. I just... I keep telling myself I'm... a terrible person, really. Just for resenting the disruption at home. I... I tend to replay every impatient look I give, or every sharp comment I make. It just... it feels like proof that my husband... that the family would probably be better off without me.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried much of the time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think I've been particularly anxious. Just... dealing with everything else, I suppose. But no, not really worried.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?

Um... yeah, I suppose it's changed. It's just... all over the place. Lately I just... I might pick at a piece of toast, or just have coffee. And then... I'll get to the end of a shift at the clinic and realize I haven't really eaten anything all day.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energetic or high, very different from your normal self?

Um... I don't know about high, exactly. But... earlier this month, I guess I did feel... strange. Sort of... electrically upbeat, I suppose. But then I'd just... snap. Over nothing. A misplaced medication cup at the clinic, or... someone changing the morning schedule. I just... it wasn't like me. I was just so on edge with everyone.
During that time earlier this month when you felt electrically upbeat, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. During that stretch, I was only sleeping... maybe three hours a night. But I'd still get up before sunrise and... I felt sharp. I just... I was convinced I didn't really need more rest than that.
During that stretch earlier this month, did you find yourself taking on a lot more activities or projects than usual?

I guess so. Um... I kept busy. I picked up some extra shifts. And... at home, I sort of redid the whole household care schedule. I started calling contractors and... I don't know, trying to coordinate everyone's tasks. Like it was some major hospital project. Even though... nobody actually asked me to take all that on. I just... did.
During that upbeat stretch earlier this month, did you do anything unusually risky or impulsive for you?

I... well, I suppose I did buy some things. Um... just supplies for the animals. Monitoring equipment, some ramps, extra bedding. It just... it felt like we needed it right then. Urgently. I didn't really think about it until later, when I saw the credit card statement. I... I charged more than we can actually pay for right now.
About that electrically upbeat stretch earlier this month, did it last at least four days in a row?
Um... yeah, I think so. It was... definitely a few days, at least. Maybe longer, I... I didn't really track the exact days. But it was a solid stretch.
